market_snapshot.entry_trigger: NIFTY remains below VWAP with sustained bearish price action and bearish Change-OI; OI support=22500.00 is the T1/breakdown reference when available.
market_snapshot.invalidation_rule: Invalidate bearish structure after sustained VWAP reclaim with opposing Change-OI and decisive bullish price structure; a small 3m bounce alone does not invalidate the trend.
